name: MiniMud
english_description: A genuine pre-LDMud, Amylaar-driver-era testbed skeleton -- only 19 files (7 commands, one room, one player class, master + simul_efun). Not a game, a driver-feature demo: register with a bare name (no password), one starting room, look/say/who/ls, plus two wizard debug tools (eval -- compile and run an arbitrary LPC expression on the spot; update -- destruct and reload a single object).
